summary: 24-year-old climber overdue on the multi-pitch Naked Edge route (5.11b) in Eldorado Canyon State Park after depleting all headlamp batteries and draining his cell phone battery; family called 911 at ~1:49 a.m. Thursday; Boulder Police Department drone located him and Rocky Mountain Rescue Group assisted him down the technical descent in a ~6-hour operation.
location: Naked Edge, Eldorado Canyon State Park
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Boulder Police Department (drone); Boulder County Communications Center
notes: Boulder County safety reminder: tell someone your outdoor plans, establish check-in procedures, bring appropriate equipment.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: county (Boulder County, Colorado, United States)
